name: JuxtaCode
tagline: Review Git history, compare branches, and resolve conflicts in a three-way merge editor.
description:
JuxtaCode is a Mac interface for inspecting changes in a Git repository. It connects commits, file history, and conflicts so you can see where a change came from before deciding how to merge it.

## Features
- Compare two branches or commits side by side.
- Trace a file across renames and search the commit timeline.
- Resolve conflicts in a three-way editor and export comparisons as PDF or PNG.

## Privacy and requirements
JuxtaCode opens repositories you select on your Mac. Resolving conflicts can change working files, so review the resulting Git diff before committing.

## Pricing
The developer offers a trial and a one-time purchase, with separate direct and Mac App Store purchase options.
